title: Maxsus checker — joylashuvi boshqa javob checker'ga yetadi
measures: PE oldindan qaytarilmaydi: tokenlari bir xil, qatorlari boshqa javobni checker hal qiladi
must_hold: 2026-10-07 gacha bu javob checker chaqirilmasdan PE olardi

program.source:
"""Checker: two positive integers whose sum is the number in the input."""
import sys

n = int(open(sys.argv[1]).read().split()[0])
try:
    a, b = map(int, open(sys.argv[2]).read().split())
except ValueError:
    sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0 if a >= 1 and b >= 1 and a + b == n else 1)
